verdicts.reason: Both turn the vertical poster into a flat one-line strip. The rose, the original's hero image, shrinks to a tiny thumbnail jammed against the right and bottom edges, and the two PRAY lines lose their place as the payoff of each phrase. A: the first PRAY is noticeably smaller than the second, so the two halves don't match, and the divider almost touches the first PRAY. Its spacing is otherwise more even. B: the two PRAYs match in size, but the text is cramped. PRAY and 'When Life Is Great' butt right up against the divider, and the second PRAY nearly collides with the rose, leaving a big empty gap after 'Rough' that is out of proportion.
